SELECT reg.user_code FROM yh_user_reginfo reg LEFT JOIN yh_user_role_power role_power ON reg.user_code=role_power.userId LEFT JOIN yh_user_role role ON role_power.roleId=role.role_id
WHERE reg.User_Type=1 AND reg.Org_Code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{org},'%')

SELECT reg.user_code,reg.user_name,reg.name,reg.Org_Code,reg.lock_flag,role.role_name FROM yh_user_reginfo reg LEFT JOIN yh_user_role_power role_power ON reg.user_code=role_power.userId LEFT JOIN yh_user_role role ON role_power.roleId=role.role_id WHERE reg.User_Type=4
AND reg.Org_Code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{org},'%')

SELECT * FROM `yh_food_cookbook2` x
f_type!=10 AND is_del=2 and F_C_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%',#{val},'%')
ORDER BY LENGTH(REPLACE(F_C_NAME,#{val},''))/LENGTH(F_C_NAME),Used_Food DESC
select count(*) from yh_food_cookbook2 where F_C_NAME=#{fCName} and F_C_ID!=#{fCId}

SELECT `F_C_ID` as fCId, `F_C_NAME` as fCName,Not_Recommend_Food as notRecommendFood FROM `yh_food_cookbook2` WHERE f_type=#{ftype}
and F_C_NAME LIKE concat('%',#{val},'%')
ORDER BY LENGTH(REPLACE(F_C_NAME,#{val},''))/LENGTH(F_C_NAME),Used_Food DESC
ORDER BY Used_Food DESC

select count(*) from yh_food_cookbook2 book,yh_food_category cate
book.F_type=cate.id
AND ( book.F_C_NAME like CONCAT('%',#{fCName},'%' ) )
AND ( book.F_type=#{fType} )
order by book.F_C_ID desc
